title: Velvet Choker
description: Gain 1 at the start of each turn. You cannot play more than [blue]6[/blue] cards per turn.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Increases maximum energy by 1 and enforces a card-play limit of 6 cards per turn. The counter resets at the start of each turn and after combat ends. The display amount shows the number of cards played in the current turn during combat.
